title: Collaborative MR Soma Cube
description: Multiplayer mixed reality puzzle game where distributed users manipulate Soma cube pieces on a shared physical table surface. Built with Unity & Photon Network, with spatial anchor coordinate alignment for sub-centimetre accuracy.

title: Spatial Anchor Coordinate Mapping
description: Floor-anchor-based algorithm aligning scanned room coordinates with generated room systems using quaternion remapping, enabling consistent object placement across heterogeneous mixed reality environments.

title: HPC Workflow Automation
description: Shell scripting suite for GPU node job submission on the Phoenix cluster, with Python environment management, automated result collection, and error-resilient job scheduling.
